info.title: MonKado API
info.description: Versioned Go API. Timestamps are UTC; nullable properties are always serialized.

post.summary: Resolve one explicitly selected product image.
post.description: Requires an authenticated owner of an active wishlist. Downloads only the submitted image through the public-only transport, without analyzing a product page or persisting data. Destinations and every redirect are validated; source bytes and image dimensions are bounded.

patch.description: Requires authenticated ownership and a current strong If-Match ETag. Foreign private lists return 404, suspended lists return 409, and stale versions return 412. Only isArchived is accepted. Archives preserve wishes, reservations and the existing share link, while hiding shared access and preventing content mutations. Restoring re-enables the same share link. An unchanged state does not change the version or timestamps.

get.description: Private groups require accepted membership. Invitations never grant list access. All accepted members have equal rights to manage the group, its photo, invitations, join link and membership. Any member may leave; the group is deleted when its last member leaves. Each list owner explicitly shares their own lists. All accesses are rechecked server-side; removal, leaving, archive and suspension revoke group-derived access. Public links and subscriptions remain independent. Reservations use global quantities, disclose no other participant identities and are unavailable to the list owner through group routes. Owners use their existing wishlist view. Mutations are atomic; reads never enroll or reserve. Invitations expire after 14 days. Group limit: 100 members including pending invitations; member limit: 50 groups.

Each list owner explicitly shares their own lists. All accesses are rechecked server-side; removal, leaving, archive and suspension revoke group-derived access. Public links and subscriptions remain independent. Reservations use global quantities, disclose no other participant identities and are unavailable to the list owner through group routes. Owners use their existing wishlist view. Mutations are atomic; reads never enroll or reserve. Invitations expire after 14 days. Group limit: 100 members including pending invitations; member limit: 50 groups.

Joining locks membership/capacity atomically, consumes any pending named invitation, and preserves independent sharing. Revocation invalidates the link, code and QR immediately for new joins; existing memberships remain. No join code is returned by public reads. Named invitations still require recipient acceptance.
